name: HeaderNavigation
description: Horizontal header navigation with navigation items grouped into left and right sections. Provides a flexible layout for organising navigation links, logos, and action buttons in a top header bar.

notes: Renders as a <nav> element with aria-label for landmark identification.
Use HeaderNavigationLeft and HeaderNavigationRight to semantically group items.
All interactive children must be keyboard accessible with visible focus indicators.

children.description: Content to render inside the header navigation. Typically HeaderNavigationLeft and HeaderNavigationRight sub-components.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use HeaderNavigationLeft for branding and primary links.
Use HeaderNavigationRight for secondary actions and user controls.
Provide aria-label to distinguish this navigation landmark from others.
dont: Do not use HeaderNavigation for vertical or sidebar navigation.
Do not nest HeaderNavigation inside another navigation component.
Do not place interactive elements directly without grouping them in left or right sections.
